title: Exact Simulation of Multivariate Diffusions and Bridges
summary: We provide the first generic exact sampling algorithms with finite expected total cost for uniformly elliptic multivariate diffusions and the corresponding diffusion bridges with bounded coefficients and bounded continuous first derivatives. We formulate a computational cost model that counts work in terms of generation of Gaussian and uniform random variables to execute acceptance--rejection sampling, as well as function evaluations of the drift and diffusion coefficients, together with elementary operations such as sums and multiplications.
